issues: 画面底部常驻调试字幕 morphTo(shapeA)/morphTo(shapeB)
形体只是一根 2px 霓虹细线 + 14% 平涂填充，没有体积和受光
140 点用 L 直线段拼接，放大到 1080p 后轮廓靠点密度硬撑
纯色 #0a0b10 背景，形体发光却照不亮周围空间
changes: 去掉调试字幕，画面只留形体本身
体积化：左上受光的径向渐变填充 + 外圈辉光 + 渐变描边 + 裁在轮廓内的内沿高光；内核柔光滞后 5f 跟随变形，读作“里面的流体慢半拍”
改为 1920×1080 原生坐标作画，140 个采样点用闭合 Catmull-Rom 转三次贝塞尔，轮廓真正光滑
带色相的深底 + 随色相染色、变形中途略增亮的环境柔光 + 暗角 + 颗粒
issuesEn: A debug caption morphTo(shapeA)/morphTo(shapeB) sat at the bottom of every frame
The form was a 2px neon line with a flat 14% fill, no volume or lighting
The 140 points were joined with straight L segments, relying on density for smoothness at 1080p
Flat #0a0b10 background; the glowing form lit nothing around it
changesEn: Removed the debug caption; the frame holds only the form
Volume: top-left-lit radial gradient fill, outer bloom, gradient rim and an inner-edge highlight clipped to the outline; an inner glow core follows the morph 5f late, like fluid lagging inside
Drawn in native 1920×1080 coordinates; the 140 samples are joined by a closed Catmull-Rom → cubic Bézier, so the outline is truly smooth
Hue-tinted dark base with an ambient glow that follows the hue and brightens slightly mid-morph, plus vignette and grain
